data.description:
This version will only work for SPT 4.0.x

Changes

  • Adjusted load order

Bugs Squashed

  • Fixed incorrect locale wording for Against the Conscience Part 2

This version will only work for SPT 4.0.10+

New Features

  • Modded weapons will now be added the to kill conditions for Against the Conscience Part 2
  • This goes by whatever parent the author of the mod weapon assigned, don’t complain to me if for some reason you have a modded SMG that isn’t counting for SMG kills.

Bugs Squashed

  • I’m stupid and forgot I changed the build method which resulted in a missing db folder

Thank you @mikedis36

This version will only work for SPT 4.1.x

New Features

  • Loyalty Level Multiplier (So you can set your own loyalty levels, default is 0.85 which makes LL4 0.96)
  • Added config to SIC

Changes

  • Changed ChangeLoyalty4RepRequirements to ChangeLoyaltyLevelRequirements which enables the multiplier to work
  • Adjusted TGH quests to 10, 15, 20, 25, 50 PMC kills
  • Adjusted Against the Conscience Part 2 to 10 kills for each weapon class (down from 50)

This version will only work for SPT 3.9.x

Initial Release

This version will only work for SPT 3.9.x

I made the quests easier. That’s all.

This version will only work for SPT 3.9.x

  • Added missing items
    • Grumpy’s hideout key
    • Voron’s hideout key
    • Leon’s hideout key
    • Weapon Case
    • Item Case
    • T H I C C Weapon Case
    • T H I C C Item Case

This version will only work for SPT 3.10.x

3.10 Update

REQUIRES 3.10 VERSION OF VCQL

  • Removed unnecessary assort changes due to SPT updates
  • Locked Gladius behind quest reward as it is in live
  • Adjusted mod to REPLACE the first 3 TGH quests instead of creating a second copy

This version will only work for SPT 3.10.x

  • Added missing weapons to Against The Conscience - Part 2
    • SR-3M
    • AUG A3 (Black)
    • G36
    • M60E4
    • M60E6
    • UZI

This version will only work for SPT 3.10.x

Changes

  • LL4 Requirement Changed from 1.2 to 1.0 (doesn’t match Live, but Live has more sources of Rep)
  • Adjusted GP Coin rewards to better match live
  • Adjusted TraderStanding reward on “To Great Heights! - Part 3” to match live

NOTE: Provide Viewership will be added in a future version (when the quest data is available in the BE, so I’m not duplicating it again like 3.9.X version)

This version will only work for SPT 3.11.x

3.11 Update

Changes

  • Added new weapons
  • Updated properties on quests even though they aren’t used

This version will only work for SPT 4.0.x

Changes

  • No longer requires VCQL
  • Add AK-50 to allowed weapons for Against The Conscience replacement

New Features

  • Toggle Ref LL4 Lower Rep Requirement (enabled by default)
  • GP Coin Reward Multiplier
  • Toggle adding Lega Medals to rewards for each quest (enabled by default)
